project("board" C)

# Board stage: sits between the soc stage (soc_init) and the
# application. board.c programs the PL from fpga_img[] and brings up
# board-level pins; board_fpga.c/h are generated by hand via the VSCode
# task "Convert PL bitstream" (tools/convert_bitstream.py) from bitstream.bin
# in this folder, so both the source image and the generated array live
# here and stay in sync without any build magic. The app target compiles
# both sources; this subdirectory only exports the include path.
add_library("board" INTERFACE)

target_sources("board"
    INTERFACE
    "board.c"
    "board_fpga.c"
)

target_include_directories("board"
    INTERFACE
    "."
)

target_link_libraries("board" 
    INTERFACE
    "soc"
)

if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/board_fpga.c")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "board_fpga.c is missing - run the VSCode task \"Convert PL bitstream\" "
        "(or: python tools/convert_bitstream.py source/board/bitstream.bin "
        "source/board/board_fpga.c source/board/board_fpga.h)")
endif()
